text: They will be asked to comment on the design of everyday articles such as a chair and a motor-car. The idea is to see what happens when parts of the mind not normally available without hypnosis are used. Muggeridge's appointment will be with Sir Roy Welensky the Premier of the Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland (10.30 p.m.). They will be asked to convey their opinion on his design of these articles.
name: Malcolm Muggeridge
